git_clone.description: Clone a repository from a remote URL or local path. Accepts HTTP(S), SSH, git://, file://, and bare filesystem paths, with optional shallow cloning.

bare.description: Create a bare repository (no working directory).

branch.description: Specific branch to clone (defaults to remote HEAD). Must not start with "-".

depth.description: Create a shallow clone with history truncated to N commits.

path.description: Destination path where the repository should be cloned. Must not start with "-".

url.description: Git repository URL: HTTP(S), SSH (ssh://… or user@host:path), git://, file://, or an absolute filesystem path. Must not start with "-" and no segment may start with "-".
